'''''Guarianthe''''', abbreviated '''''Gur.''''' in the horticultural trade,<ref>http://www.rhs.org.uk/RHSWebsite/files/87/87be8b1e-908e-4e04-9ee6-30c438354458.pdf{{dead link|date=March 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> is a small genus of [[epiphytic]] [[orchid]]s, growing in wet forests in Mexico, Central America, Colombia, Venezuela and Trinidad.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=247363|title=World Checklist of Selected Plant Families: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|website=apps.kew.org|language=en-GB|access-date=2018-02-28}}{{Dead link|date=June 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> It was separated from the bifoliate ''[[Cattleya]]''s in 2003,<ref>Dressler and Higgins: "''Guarianthe'', a Generic Name for the ''“Cattleya” skinneri'' Complex" ''Lankesteriana''  '''7'''(2003)37—38  [http://www.lankesteriana.ucr.ac.cr/lankesteriana/Lankesteriana%20vol.%203.%202003/Lankesteriana%20N%207/Numeroporsecciones/16%20Dressler%20&%20Higgins.pdf] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110718162651/http://www.lankesteriana.ucr.ac.cr/lankesteriana/Lankesteriana%20vol.%203.%202003/Lankesteriana%20N%207/Numeroporsecciones/16%20Dressler%20%26%20Higgins.pdf|date=2011-07-18}}</ref> based on phylogenetic studies of nuclear DNA sequence data.<ref>van den Berg et al.: "A Phylogenetic Analysis of Laeliinae (Orchidaceae) based on Sequence Data from Internal Transcribed Spacers (ITS)of Nuclear Ribosomal DNA", ''Lindleyana'' ''15''(2)96—114.  2000.  [http://www.cassiovandenberg.com/pdfs/2000-cvdb005.pdf] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110708123124/http://www.cassiovandenberg.com/pdfs/2000-cvdb005.pdf|date=2011-07-08}}</ref>
